blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marcos administration underscores mining’s strategic importance as Mining Philippines 2026 draws international participation. Department of Environment and Natural Resources Secretary Juan Miguel Cuna, who delivered President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s keynote message to the conference, joins Chamber of Mines of the Philippines Chairman Michael Toledo (right) in the ceremonial ribbon-cutting at Conrad Manila on October 27. The two-day Mining Philippines 2026 International Conference and Exhibition gathered 300 delegates from government, academe, mining, and allied industries. Marking several milestones, the event featured the President’s message for the second consecutive year and, for the first time, partnerships with the Embassies […]...
